core_categories: Home Modifications; Patient Mobility Equipment; Stairlifts; Home Lifts; Home Elevators; Wheelchair Lifts; Accessible Bathrooms
specialty_focus: Mobility123 is a family-owned accessibility business and specialty distributor based in New Jersey, providing home modifications, patient mobility equipment, and installation services. They specialize in empowering seniors and disabled individuals to maintain independence at home, offering stairlifts, home lifts, home elevators, wheelchair lifts, and accessible bathrooms. They do not appear to deal in wearable medical devices.
